recipes.label: Command Allies to Attack an Enemy
recipes.startdescription:
The enemy is ahead. I will need a strategy, and then the resources and manpower to execute it. Or, failing that, a willingness to throw away the lives of my allies.

[Meet any of an Enemy's thresholds to launch an attack against it. Exceed a threshold by at least 5 of the appropriate aspect, and the attack will be a guaranteed success. You can only do three of these simulatenously.]

recipes.label: Spread Too Thin
recipes.startdescription: I can't coordinate this many attacks at once. I'm going to have to wait for one to finish before sending more men out. [You can only do three ally attacks simultaneously.]
